cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.

cause: The clean Plan Lock worktree was verified against the existing contract and workflow registry suites before v1.8.9 contract implementation.
impact: The isolated line starts from 137 passing relevant pre-v1.8.9 contract and workflow registry tests.

impact: The four Task 1 contract tests cannot collect until the requested production contract exists.
lesson: Observe the missing-contract collection failure before implementing the public ContractRefV1 API.

cause: The required duplicate guard was temporarily removed so a later reference overwrote the existing exact identity.
impact: The duplicate resolver test failed because last-write-wins did not raise ContractRefError.
lesson: Keep the exact identity duplicate guard because the focused test detects and rejects overwrite semantics.

cause: The mutation event initially used the unsupported formal event stage value verification.
impact: The first mutation event append was rejected with EventValidationError and did not change the formal event stream.
lesson: Use the formal event schema stage vocabulary and record verification-related task events under implementation for this line.

cause: Task 1 was reviewed against the locked API, strict decoding, canonical hashing, immutability, resolver precedence, and schema-only scope.
impact: The implementation remains limited to one four-field frozen contract, one resolver, canonical helpers, stable errors, and focused tests without runtime registry changes.
lesson: Keep C0 contract references exact, fail closed, canonical, and independent of runtime authority.

cause: The restored duplicate guard and complete Task 1 implementation were exercised by the focused Contract Lock test file.
impact: All four Task 1 ContractRefV1 and resolver tests passed in the focused suite.
lesson: Require the focused contract suite after restoring mutation-tested duplicate rejection.

cause: The self-review event initially used the unsupported formal preventability value not_applicable.
impact: The first self-review event append was rejected with EventValidationError and did not change the formal event stream.
lesson: Use unknown when preventability does not apply because the formal schema does not define a not_applicable value.

cause: The sandbox denied creation of the linked-worktree Git index lock during the first explicitly scoped git add.
impact: The first staging command failed before changing the Git index; the identical path-scoped command succeeded with explicit permission.
lesson: Use explicit permission for linked-worktree Git metadata while keeping the staged path list narrow and reviewable.

cause: The final staged test content was rerun after removing the trailing blank line detected by the cached diff check.
impact: All four Task 1 tests passed against the exact final test file content selected for commit.
lesson: Bind the final focused gate to the exact test artifact after any formatting-only refactor.

cause: Code review found that regex-valid semantic version components are converted with unbounded int calls, while a separate proposal for a seventh resolver code conflicts with the locked six-code contract.
impact: Oversized regex-valid components require a bounded public error path; same-major absent minor remains CONTRACT_UNRESOLVED and no seventh code will be added.
lesson: Bound semantic version components before integer conversion while preserving the locked resolver error vocabulary.

cause: A regex-valid 5000-digit semantic version component reached Python int conversion without a public component bound.
impact: The public parser leaked raw ValueError instead of CONTRACT_VERSION_INVALID for an oversized component.
lesson: Reject oversized canonical digit components before calling int so parser failures remain stable and public-safe.

cause: Semantic version components are now bounded at signed 32-bit max before integer conversion, preserving canonical MAJOR.MINOR parsing and stable errors.
impact: The complete Task 1 file passes five tests, including max, max-plus-one, and 5000-digit component boundaries.
lesson: Keep semantic version parsing public-safe by checking bounded canonical digit text before integer conversion.

cause: The locked section 4.7 semantic requirements do not define exact public reason fields, nested NumericFact object shapes, or EvidencePersistencePort transaction record vocabularies.
impact: Task 2 tests and fixtures cannot lock a strict public from_dict and to_dict API without inventing field names, value vocabularies, or port behavior.
lesson: Resolve exact public field shapes before test-first implementation so tests enforce the approved contract instead of defining an accidental one.

cause: The first formal append supplied an absolute temporary event-file path, but the CLI requires an event source path relative to the repository.
impact: The rejected command did not alter the event stream; the append must be retried from a repository-relative temporary source.
lesson: Provide repository-relative event source paths to devline_control append and remove temporary sources after successful recording.

cause: A formal line inspection attempted the unsupported devline_control status subcommand instead of using the documented verify command surface.
impact: The inspection command exited with code 2 and made no state change; formal verification succeeded through the supported verify subcommand.
lesson: Inspect the current devline_control help and use verify because this CLI has no status subcommand.

cause: The user supplied and approved the exact minimal Task 2 public field shapes, enum vocabularies, derivation rules, persistence protocol boundary, and fixture requirements.
impact: The open Task 2 public-shape GAP is resolved before RED; tests can now lock the approved API without inventing fields or runtime behavior.
lesson: Resume contract TDD only after every strict public field and derivation rule has an approved exact shape.

cause: The approved Task 2 foundation status and evidence contract modules do not exist before implementation.
impact: The required focused Task 2 selector fails collection with ModuleNotFoundError for foundation_status before any production code is added.
lesson: Observe the missing approved public contract modules before implementing the minimal strict schemas.

cause: A targeted mutation temporarily removed the equality between fact validation_level and the strongest passing oracle basis.
impact: The required test failed because a same-library passing check could forge independent_implementation and no ContractError was raised.
lesson: Keep fact validation derived only from passing oracle bases so no fact or envelope can promote unsupported evidence.

cause: Task 2 was reviewed against the approved exact field lists, orthogonal status semantics, strict finite JSON decoding, fact-level validation derivation, immutable persistence binding, and owned-file boundary.
impact: No critical or important review issue remains; implementation is schema-only and does not alter runtime, storage, old validation contracts, or consumer behavior.
lesson: Keep validation claims fact-derived and persistence bindings content-addressed while preserving each status axis independently.

cause: The restored final Task 2 implementation was exercised by the requested focused selector, the complete Task 1 and 2 file, and explicit canonical corruption paths.
impact: Focused tests passed 3 with 9 deselected, the complete file passed 12, and four explicit corruption-path tests passed after the promotion mutation was restored.
lesson: Use the complete file as the Task 1 and 2 gate because the requested keyword selector intentionally omits several required evidence test names.

cause: Code-quality review identified unchecked duplicate identities, permissive wire mappings, canonical and malformed-value leaks, an incomplete evidence state matrix, unpinned fixture bytes, and insufficient persistence adversarial coverage.
impact: All six findings reproduce against the current Task 2 code or tests and require red-first fixes without changing public fields, enums, Task 1 behavior, runtime, or storage.
lesson: Strict public contracts must fail closed before normalization, set-based lookup, arithmetic, or persistence comparison can erase malformed distinctions.

cause: The current Task 2 contracts do not reject duplicate identities or permissive wire mappings, do not canonical-preflight frozen mappings, leak huge-int arithmetic errors, and enforce an incomplete execution-availability-completeness matrix.
impact: The focused quality slice produced 12 expected failures, including DID NOT RAISE results, an OverflowError for a canonical arbitrary integer, and rejection of valid partial and failed orthogonal states.
lesson: Prove each fail-closed boundary and valid orthogonal state before changing the public contract implementation.

cause: A targeted mutation temporarily removed the NumericFactV1 duplicate oracle check_id guard.
impact: The required identity test failed with DID NOT RAISE, proving it detects duplicate oracle identities before validation resolution.
lesson: Retain the explicit check_id uniqueness guard before deriving passing validation levels.

cause: The focused quality fix was reviewed against all six accepted findings, the locked public field surface, Task 1 containment, and the owned-file boundary.
impact: Duplicate identities fail before set resolution; wire dicts and frozen JSON fail closed; malformed values stay inside ContractError; the state matrix remains minimally orthogonal; fixture bytes and persistence bindings have adversarial coverage.
lesson: Review strict packet contracts at the pre-normalization boundary and isolate each cross-axis contradiction in tests.

cause: The restored post-mutation quality fix was exercised by the required focused selector, the complete v1.8.9 contract file, and the retained pre-v1.8.9 contract baseline.
impact: The requested selector passed 28 tests with 17 deselected, the complete file passed 45 tests, and the retained baseline passed 137 tests after restoring the duplicate-identity mutation.
lesson: Bind the final gate to exact post-mutation test content and retain the historical four-file baseline as a separate containment check.

cause: The sandbox denied creation of the linked-worktree Git index lock during the first path-scoped staging attempt.
impact: The initial git add exited 128 before changing the index; the identical narrow command succeeded with explicit linked-worktree metadata permission.
